explanation: The theorem says two maps agree. One is `splitKernelProjection`, defined in this library (ProjectiveModules/Module/ProjectiveKernel.lean). The other is the inverse of `kerProdEquivOfRightInverse`, defined in the Formal Frontier stable-range library (StableRange/Module/SplitSurjective.lean). I grepped for `kerProdEquivOfRightInverse` in Mathlib and found nothing, so it is not a Mathlib declaration. All the content of the theorem lies in these two non-Mathlib definitions. No Mathlib declaration can state the result, and Mathlib contributes only routine extensionality glue (`LinearMap.ext`, `Prod.ext`, `Subtype.ext`).
